currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful cathedral aerial/tower photographs and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys, printed-plan tracing or photograph redistribution.

pictures.observations: Elevated north view: tall western brick shaft with pale blind arcades, brown copper clock roof, open lantern and bulbous cap; long steep gray metal nave roof, lower aisles and projecting north transept/porch. Small roof dormers/vents and lower adjoining ranges read separately. Current roof color is copper-brown rather than green.

West tower close view: four distinct brick arcade/window tiers, cream blind panels and cornices, paired rounded/pointed dark openings, lower circular window and copper clock/lantern silhouette. Exact brick tracery, clock numerals, sculpture, weathercock shape and unseen portal design are not reconstructed.
